diagnosis.surface: H-allow (committed run_cell cell machinery — the ST5 verify leg — and the hh-w1 deny-evidence fold)
diagnosis.root_cause: two coupled machinery defects, verified against the Wc3 harvest (fp-wc3/run-root.tar.gz, e.g. trials/torch-tensor-parallelism/H-allow/r0): (1) crates/hh-runner/src/cell.rs `run_cell` ST5 never ensured `/logs/verifier` exists in the cell. The staged verifier (`bash /tests/test.sh`) ends with `echo 0|1 > /logs/verifier/reward.txt` — the dir is created only by the pytest ctrf plugin on the happy path. On `allowlist_mediated` cells the verifier's apt bootstrap is denied under the frozen allowlist (mediator WAL: `security.egress.decided{deny, not_allowed, default_unmatched}` for archive.ubuntu.com / security.ubuntu.com — the frozen fp-w1-q-x55 list carries Debian-family apt hosts; the task images are Ubuntu noble — declared data, untouched), pytest never runs, the dir never exists, the `reward.txt` write fails, and every verify attempt's copy-out finds nothing — `exited{0}` → `verifier_unavailable:reward_missing` on all H-allow cells (Wc2 + Wc3 verbatim). (2) crates/hh-runner/src/bin/hh_w1.rs `collect_denied`/`collect_hosts` hunted a bare `host` member the decided payload never carries (`host_norm`/`host_raw` are the committed members — crates/hh-env/src/bin/hh_egress_mediator.rs via egress.rs `egress_decided_payload`): every live deny folded to `denied_hosts: []` (the recorded mis-signature) and produced zero `MediatorRow`s — the §3.4 classifier's `bootstrap:egress_denied` leg could never fire even had a reward landed. The same fold also could not attribute phase: any deny in the run counted as verify-phase evidence.

repair.scope: machinery only — `run_cell`'s ST5 leg in crates/hh-runner/src/cell.rs, the deny-evidence fold moved into crates/hh-runner/src/verdict.rs (`denied_hosts`), and the hh-w1 call site in crates/hh-runner/src/bin/hh_w1.rs; the drawn tasks, surfaces O/H-pub/H-allow, the R/R admit rule, the frozen allowlist and the committed replacement orders are untouched; no new record kind or schema; the CellOps signature is unchanged
repair.act_1: cell.rs — the ST5 leg runs `mkdir -p /logs/verifier` in-cell before the verifier exec (the reward sink is lifecycle-owned like `/tests`; stage_in already mkdirs its destination). A verifier whose bootstrap dies before the pytest leg still lands its trailing `reward.*` write — `exited{0}` now yields a produced reward (`0` under a denied bootstrap) instead of `reward_missing`.
repair.act_2: verdict.rs — `denied_hosts(events, verify_version_id)` folds `security.egress.decided` rows: `decision == "deny"` matched as a member (not a substring), hosts collected from `host_norm`/`host_raw` (bare `host` retained), and verify-phase attribution by `policy_version_id == <verify layer's version_id>` — an agent-layer deny is not verifier-bootstrap evidence. hh_w1.rs extracts `version_id` from the sealed verify layer and calls the fold; `denied_hosts` now records the real verify-phase denies and the `MediatorRow`s drive `bootstrap:egress_denied`.
